品牌标志以独特的方式展现品牌愿景和品牌理念。每个标志的正确应用都是对品牌资产的贡献，和对品牌价值的体现。
商标是由文字标识构成，符号与文字的间距为恒定比例，任何情况下均不可随意调整比例布局或单独使用文字标识。
The brand logo presents the brand vision and philosophy in a unique way. The correct application of each logo is a contribution to brand assets and a reflection of brand value.
A trademark is composed of textual symbols, with a constant proportion between the symbols and the text. Under no circumstances can the proportion layout be adjusted or the textual symbols be used separately.
